categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xintian Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of radio frequency (RF) devices, RF metal components, and RF structural parts for the mobile communication industry. Its core products include filters, antennas, resonators, tuning screws, low-pass components, transmission rods, and coupling capacitors, mainly used in mobile communication base stations. The company also develops products for the new energy and medical device sectors, though these are currently in early growth stages.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in RF device design and precision CNC machining processes. It employs lean production management and rapid changeover techniques to handle small batch, multi-variety production. The manufacturing process emphasizes in-house production of core and precision processes, with external processing limited to non-core steps. The company also uses ERP systems for production planning and inventory management, and has developed various specialized tooling and testing equipment to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global and domestic leading mobile communication main equipment manufacturers and RF device suppliers, including Nokia, Sanmina-SCI, Flextronics, and CommScope. The company targets the mobile communication base station market, serving operators and equipment makers primarily in 5G infrastructure. It also serves emerging markets in new energy, medical devices, and automotive components, though these sectors currently contribute less to revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas presence including manufacturing bases in Hungary and Vietnam, and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and the United States. Its sales are distributed between domestic (58%) and international markets (42%), with major international markets including Europe, North America, and Asia (excluding China). The company is expanding its overseas production and business systems to mitigate global trade risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xintian Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of RF components and metal parts that are critical inputs for mobile communication base station equipment manufacturers. It sources raw materials such as copper, aluminum, and stainless steel, and supplies customized components directly to major equipment makers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment focusing on RF metal components and devices aligned with mobile communication technology trends, especially 5G. It pursues both synchronous and proactive R&D to meet and anticipate customer needs, enhancing product design, materials, processes, and functions. Additionally, it is increasing R&D efforts in new energy, medical devices, and automotive sectors. The company plans to accelerate overseas production base construction and expand its one-stop service system to strengthen market position.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized RF devices and metal components to major communication equipment manufacturers. The company operates on an order-based production model, with sales contracts typically established via framework agreements with key customers. Other minor revenue streams include rental income and sales of scrap materials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The RF metal components and devices industry is fragmented with many small-scale competitors. Xintian Technology positions itself as a high-tech, integrated supplier with strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities, serving top-tier global communication equipment makers. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive service capabilities, high-quality customer relationships, lean production, and cost leadership. The company faces competition risks from price wars and customer demand fluctuations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 277 million, a 55% decline from RMB 616 million in 2023, primarily due to the completion of large-scale projects in India and slowed 5G investments in Europe and North America. Net profit attributable to shareholders was a loss of RMB 18.3 million, reversing from a profit of RMB 60.3 million in 2023. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 655 million, with a slight decrease from the previous year. Despite recent setbacks, the company maintains stable operations and plans to recover growth through market expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xintian Technology offers highly customized, precision-engineered RF components critical for stable and interference-resistant mobile communication signals. Its value proposition lies in integrated synchronous and proactive R&D, lean manufacturing, and rapid response to customer needs, enabling it to deliver high-quality, reliable products to leading global communication equipment manufacturers. The company’s multi-location production strategy enhances cost efficiency and supply chain resilience, while its expanding product portfolio in new energy and medical sectors aims to diversify growth drivers.
